about: The ONE face vocabulary for a doorway that cannot take a write. scripts/ci/fleet-write-readiness.sh refuses to print a face that is not listed here, and genesis/a2o/steps/dataplane/app-delivery-refuses-fast.helpers.ts reads this file for the faces the household stations accept. The three plan faces are the names scripts/ci/stage-spa-blob.sh (not_ready_face) and the a2o feature use; the rest are the serving regimes and transport answers the probe also sees.

faces.meaning: the conductor behind the doorway has no running cell for this write: /health/serving rolesDiscovered 0, or any answer carrying CellDisabled
the doorway sheds with 503 {"status":"catching-up"} and a Retry-After
the doorway could not forward the probe blob to its storage peer: the forward timed out
/health/serving answered 503 for a reason not named above
a probe route answered 503 or 429 without declaring itself catching-up
the storage forward failed for a named cause other than a timeout
the doorway did not answer (connection refused, DNS, reset)
the doorway did not answer within READINESS_MAX_TIME
